title: HTTP and APIs in Practice
learning_objectives: Describe HTTP as the protocol behind most web requests
Explain what an API (Application Programming Interface) is in practical terms
Differentiate between clients, servers, and endpoints
Use a simple API testing tool (or browser) to inspect requests and responses
outline: HTTP methods (GET, POST) at a high level
APIs as structured contracts: endpoints, parameters, responses
Hands-on: calling a public JSON API and inspecting the response

format: Short answers explaining an observed API response
Screenshot or transcript of a successful API call

constraints_for_professor: Use a simple, unauthenticated public API
Avoid deep dives into status codes beyond the basics (200, 404, 500)
